title: Chicken Jockey
blurb: Two words that turned cinema screenings into public order incidents. When A Minecraft Movie arrived in April 2025, this line triggered synchronised chaos across the world: popcorn airborne, children standing on seats, staff quietly reconsidering their career paths, and several chains issuing actual warnings. It became the defining cinema-behaviour meme of the year, and a genuinely strange case of a film's audience becoming more famous than the film. Play it responsibly — which is to say, anywhere except a cinema, a school assembly, or a room containing anyone aged nine to fourteen.
origin: From A Minecraft Movie (2025) — the line that caused worldwide cinema chaos.
